## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `08f26b8bb4b1ec4dff3e4e7c74d488a30583ead8`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/security.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/project-forms.md + scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs, scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs, scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs, scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs, scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs, scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/security-findings.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/landing-operations.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/triage.md

Inputs: card #29726 (body; comments 6595030876, 6595626876, 6596935692, 6597456457 — the last is the author's account and was tested, not cited), PR #29840 (body, file list, net diff against `origin/main` at 64646aed2e: 6 files, +66/−27), the head's check-runs. The tree was judged, never the PR body's account of it.

### ① Derived judgments

Each rule the charter now states, against the verbatim rulings on the card and in amendment 6595626876:

- **Ruling 1** 「后续需要我决裁的问题，先用 fable 审核之后再和我沟通。」 → lines 32–34: any question to the maintainer is first reviewed by an isolated agent at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`; the reviewer takes the analysis and evidence and never the seat's conclusion; it checks the four axes, no missing option, the recommendation and that the evidence is real; the question carries the verdict and every dissent. Faithful; nothing widened or narrowed. The text writes the tier constant and 「⛔ 不写模型名」 — no model id anywhere in the diff (grepped).
- **Ruling 2** 「复杂的任务可以开云卡片」 → line 26: L/XL, build-heavy, long-running or browser-verified fix orders go `mode:cloud`, the rest `mode:subagent`, pointing at `../execution-duties.md` (its lines 147–152 carry the one-order-per-container and archive duties); the archive is restated on line 43. Faithful.
- **Ruling 3** 「这些都应该写到你的skills」, the per-object close-out → lines 40–43. PR: the queue merges, MERGED confirmed before the card's close-out, pointer to `../landing-operations.md` (its line 63 closes the `Fixes`/`Part of` cards in the same act). Card: `Fixes #N` closes on merge, the seat posts the landing record and removes `pm:*`; `Part of #N` the seat closes when its last part lands. Advisory: as AMENDED by 6595626876 item 1 (「目前的修复都关闭」「你处理完的可以都先关闭」) — the relay `advisory_state` move to `closed` on merge, recorded on the seat post, 「⛔ 不逐份请示」; the card's superseded "only when the maintainer names that advisory" line is correctly absent, and the old charter line 25's "pushes to `awaiting publish` and stops" is correctly gone. Cloud card archived by the seat; a subagent ends itself and removes its own worktree. Faithful.
- **Amendment item 2** 「哪些高危要发布应该在我版本发布前决策吧」 → lines 35–36: before each release, a publish-or-not list of the advisories `closed` since the last release, high and moderate first, reviewed under ruling 1 first; publishing stays the maintainer's, who reopens and publishes in the advisory UI because the relay cannot move a closed advisory. Faithful. Item 3 (batch 5) is a seat-post setting and is correctly not in the charter.
- **Ledger state words** → line 21: `received` → `fixing` → `merged` → `closed`; `awaiting publish` → `published` only for what the pre-release pick sends to publishing. Exactly the amendment's wording. The seat post #29740 ledger already uses these words; no script pins the vocabulary (grepped `scripts/` and `.claude/`: the charter is the one holder).
- **Intake and reads** → lines 18–20: a cloud seat cannot list the repository's advisories and the relay refuses the bare collection, so ids come from the maintainer or the doorbell; plaintext is printed only to the seat's own stdout with `--reveal`, never into a file, a log or a background task's output; fix claims live in the seat post's ledger. The relay-read and sender-gate halves stay as the pointer on line 12. Faithful.
- **S1** resolved: old line 12 (relay read/write only) and old line 17's 「⛔ 不换账号重发」 restated `security-findings.md` §3 (its lines 22–25); both are pointers now (lines 12, 17 → §3, §9). **S2** resolved by one sentence (line 48) plus the reader widening (③). **S3** resolved: the `MAILBOX_KEYS` `from:` and `project-forms.md` line 47 name the seat holding the finding (a dev's or runner's finding reaches its PM session first, §5), or triage for a card it labelled.
- **§8 「一处成文」**: no never-public rule from `security-findings.md` is newly restated. Lines 25 and 47 restate §3 line 28 and §7, but both predate this PR (on `main`). Should-fix, not a must: line 36 carries 「发布归维护者」, which §3 line 24 and §9 line 62 already state — a carry-over from old line 25; the new half of the line (reopen-and-publish in the UI) is the minimum new text and is right.
- **Names no finding, advisory id, path or mechanism**: checked line by line. `#N` on line 48 is a placeholder; `security-note.md`, `execution-duties.md` and `landing-operations.md` are skill references, not code paths. The seat post's ledger ids are not repeated in the tree.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` (label present; Check Changeset green): `.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**` ship in no released package. PR body carries `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`; no `(narrowing)` arm. Correct.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **`notify:security` reader widened to accept `#n`.** The field is the one slot after the key; an opaque public-card number names no mechanism (the card is already public, and the mailbox PR is public either way), and the reader refuses a card beside an id, a second field, `PR #n`, `#0` and the verbatim template — read in the new reader (`NUMBER_REF` is anchored `^#[1-9][0-9]*$`) and pinned by the new self-test row. Template `Notify: security · GHSA-ID or #n`: sent verbatim it splits into two parts, the second matches neither shape, so the "a template is not an event" pin still holds. `mailboxEvents`/H72 only count unread rows, so the new `card`/`numbers` fields change no sweep. The measured half is real: triage's ring on the seat's mailbox (comment 6595011108) is exactly `To: security#1` / `Notify: security · #29761`, which the `main` reader cannot read. Safe; the smaller fix was the right one (no new key, no new gate, no new label — card's 「⛔ No new gate」 and §8's 「不新增门禁、不新增标签」 held).
- **`fleet-roster` importing `check-half-states`.** Verified on the head: `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs` line 482 statically imports `check-half-states.mjs` (line 484 imports `ROSTER_MARKER` from `fleet-roster.mjs`), so the deleted mirror's "the relay never loads the patrol" reason was already false — the claim is true. No cycle: `check-half-states.mjs` imports only `invoked-as.mjs` and `seat-record.mjs` statically and `record-recognisers.mjs` / `mailbox-open.mjs` lazily inside a function; nothing in that closure imports `fleet-roster.mjs`. No load-order risk: the only two importers of `fleet-roster.mjs` (`dispatch.mjs`, `check-owed-reviews.mjs`) already import `check-half-states.mjs`, and its `process.exit` paths sit under the `isEntrypoint` guard. `SEAT_SIGNATURE_LINE` carries flag `u` only, so the shared regex object is stateless under `exec`. The old `SIGNATURE_LINE` has no leftover reference.
- **`mailbox-open` self-test holds the lane grammars equal, `coordinator` aside.** The pin lives in `fleet-roster`'s self-test (the one file importing both), not in `mailbox-open`. It parses the alternation out of `SEAT_SIGNATURE_LINE.source` and requires kinds = `SEAT_LANE_KINDS` + `epic` and bare words = `SEAT_BARE_LANES` + `coordinator`, with the total length pinned (7 on this tree). A lane added to either side alone reds it. `mailbox-open.mjs` itself changes only a comment, and the stated reason it cannot import the patrol (lazy load from the patrol; H72 pins that) matches `check-half-states.mjs` line 28287 and its measured top-level-await note. The `coordinator` exception is stated in both files and is the card's own carve-out.
- **Ratchet row +19.** `lanes/security.md` is 53 lines on the head (34 on `main`), every line ≤ 120 bytes; the row moves 34 → 53, headroom 0, no other row moves. The comment cites the card body (rulings 1–3 verbatim there) and amendment comment 6595626876 as the ruling record, which is what the card's acceptance asks; the file's other rows cite cards the same way.
- **Acceptance-notes items.** (a) `fleet-roster.mjs` line 275's `isEpicParent` header repeats the stale "relay never loads the patrol" reason — true on the head, a comment only, correctly left. (b) `security-findings.md` §9 line 61 still says the finder rings `Notify: security · GHSA-ID` — still true for a finder's draft; the `#n` form is triage's, and the claim limits that file to pointers. (c) `SKILL.md` line 61 routes `security`-labelled CARDS to `thread` when the seat is a project thread; line 26 governs the seat's no-card fix orders. Different objects, no conflict.

### ④ Design judgment

- **`lanes/security.md`** holds against the cited code and the rulings. Each pointer resolves on the head: `../execution-duties.md` lines 147–152, `../landing-operations.md` lines 45–73, `security-findings.md` §3/§6/§7/§9, `triage.md` line 16–17. Close-on-merge (line 42) does not conflict with §3 (line 24 reserves publishing, not closing) or §7 (line 51 reserves closing the public ISSUE, which line 47 still reserves; the relay `closed` move is on the advisory). Ruling 1 is free of model ids. Trying to break it: the one soft spot is line 48 — 「本席巡查自读 open 的 `security` 标签卡,标签即转交;分诊敲 … 只为提速」. Seat post #29740 records `Patrol: none` (an on-demand seat, the exception `seat-lifecycle.md` line 86 allows), so for the seat as currently held the doorbell is the instrument that reaches it, not a speed-up. The rule is still right at the charter level (line 39 of `seat-lifecycle.md` makes a patrol part of seating; present-tense seat state lives on the seat post, not here), and the reader widening makes the hand-over work either way. Should-fix: spell the no-patrol case (「无巡查时门铃即转交」) in the next edit of this file.
- **`project-forms.md`** line 47: the 〈信箱 PR〉 table pin in `record-recognisers` (every key named, no other) still holds — the key is unchanged. Nit: it attributes the labelled-card ring to 「持发现的席」 while the `MAILBOX_KEYS` row says triage; the two are the same actor for a labelled card and the line stays ≤ 120 bytes, so no change asked.
- **Gates on the head** (their conclusions are the verdicts): `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates` (carries `check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:pm-record-recognisers` — the four self-tests), `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint · CI, release & engine gates`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Check Changeset`, `Check PR Size`, `PR-body guards`, `Test UI`, `Test Core (2/8)` — all `success`. Still running at write time: `Test Core (1/8)`. `Build Core`, `Lint UI`, `Type Check UI`, `Build & E2E UI`, `Live E2E UI` are path-skipped. No failure. The PR is draft on the base repository (no fork), no reviewers, no approving review — Tier S landing waits on this record and the last shard.

No must-fix. Should-fix (line 48's no-patrol case; line 36's carried-over 「发布归维护者」) and the line-47 nit are for the next edit of these files, not this PR.
